trap.label: adjetivo + preposição (uso)
trap.wrong: I am keen of reading. She is afraid of to fly. He is good in organize.
trap.right: I am keen on reading. She is afraid of flying. He is good at organizing.
trap.why: Em português “gosto muito de ler”, “medo de voar” usam de. O brasileiro generaliza of/in. Em inglês, cada adjetivo tem sua preposição (keen on, afraid of, good at) e depois vem -ing.

fix.wrong: He is afraid of to speak.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com keen: “I like using apps a lot.”
rewrite.answer: I am keen on using apps.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com good: “She reads very well.”
